name: Bannerman Energy Ltd
summary: Bannerman Energy Ltd explores for and develops uranium properties in Africa. The company's flagship property is the 95% owned Etango Project located in the Erongo Region of Namibia, Southern Africa. The company was formerly known as Bannerman Resources Limited and changed its name to Bannerman Energy Ltd in July 2021. Bannerman Energy Ltd was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
